title: Yellowed Crumbly Mediterranean Lamb Tagine
description: A cultured and crumbly Mediterranean dish featuring lamb, rice wine, and traditional tagine cooking, perfect for a midnight craving, and suitable for a satvik friendly diet.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it starts to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the rice wine, ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the tagine from the heat and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the lamb and sauce over couscous or rice, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
